color.comment: The default ring colour, the same sage as border.brand. A component whose background is too close to it defines its own focus-ring token in tier 3.

offset.comment: Stroke geometry, not layout spacing: the gap matches the ring width, so it stays off the 4px spacing scale.

offset-inset.comment: Draws the ring inside the element, for items in clipped or tightly packed containers: menu options, tabs, table cells.
